extras.textures: PBR 2048px: base color, roughness, metallic, normal (baked)
extras.real_size: ATX mid tower PC case, approx. 215 x 460 x 477 mm
extras.notes: empty case, front faces -Y; white steel body with rounded edges on four feet, honeycomb mesh front with sky blue trim, top dust filter and front panel (power button, two USB ports, audio jack), rear I/O cut-out, 120 mm fan grille, seven slot covers, PSU opening; inside: motherboard tray with brass standoffs, CPU cut-out, cable grommets and PSU shroud. Movable: tempered glass side panel 'pc-case_side_panel' on +X (origin on the rear hinge edge, rotates around Z, positive angle opens outward). No text, no logos

origin.detail: Built procedurally with Blender scripts. The scripts were written with the help of an AI coding assistant. No generative AI model produced the geometry or textures directly.
